_note: Hand-written reference-quality video summaries used as RAG style/depth guidance. Review and edit these for quality and house style before running a real evaluation. Each entry: id, category, text (2-3 sentences, plain prose, concrete subject + action + outcome, no markdown).

references.text: A woman in a grey apron kneads dough on a floured wooden counter, folding and pressing it with the heel of her hand. She pauses to scrape the surface clean, then shapes the dough into a round and covers it with a cloth. The kitchen is bright and unhurried, with morning light from a window on the left.

Two men on a subway platform greet each other with a handshake that turns into a brief hug. They talk animatedly while checking the arrivals board, and step apart as a train pulls in. One carries a duffel bag, suggesting one of them has just arrived or is about to leave.

A street musician plays acoustic guitar and sings on a busy sidewalk, an open case with a few coins in front of him. Passers-by mostly keep walking, but a child stops to watch and drops in a coin while a parent waits. The performer nods thanks without breaking the song.

A teacher stands at a whiteboard explaining a diagram to a small group of students seated at tables. She points to different parts of the sketch, asks a question, and waits while a student answers. Two students take notes; one raises a hand near the end.

A toddler in a striped shirt takes several wobbling steps across a living room toward an adult crouched with arms open. The child falls onto hands and knees once, laughs, pushes back up, and completes the last few steps into the adult's arms. A second person films from a couch.

A barista steams milk and pours a leaf pattern into a latte, then slides the cup across the counter to a waiting customer. The cafe is busy, with other orders lined up on the bar. The customer takes the cup, adds nothing to it, and leaves the frame.

A golden retriever sprints across an open grass field, ears flat and tongue out, chasing a green tennis ball. It skids as it reaches the ball, grabs it, and turns to run back toward a person off-screen. The grass is bright and freshly cut, and the light is low and warm.

A grey cat crouches on a windowsill tracking a bird outside, tail twitching. It chatters its jaw, shifts its weight, then loses interest and settles into a loaf position facing the glass. Rain streaks the window throughout.

A pod of dolphins rides the bow wave of a boat, surfacing in turn and occasionally leaping clear of the water. The sea is calm and deep blue, and the boat's wake trails behind. The animals stay with the boat for the length of the clip before peeling away.

A hummingbird hovers at a red feeder, wings a blur, dipping its bill to drink between quick sideways darts. Another bird approaches and the first chases it off before returning to feed. The background is an out-of-focus green garden.

A slow wave curls and breaks along an empty beach at sunrise, sliding up the sand and drawing back over dark pebbles. Foam lingers and pops in the shallows. The horizon is orange fading to pale blue, with no people or boats in view.

A squirrel digs a shallow hole at the base of a tree, drops in an acorn, and pats the soil back with quick paw movements. It pauses to look around twice, then bounds off across a path. Dry leaves cover the ground.

A brown horse trots along a fence line in a paddock, then breaks into a canter when a second horse joins from the far side. They run together for a stretch, kicking up dust, before slowing to a walk near a water trough.

A close-up shows an espresso machine's portafilter locking into place and a double shot beginning to pour into a small cup. The stream starts pale, darkens, and slows to drips, forming a layer of crema on top. Steam rises from the cup and the group head.

A time-lapse-style shot follows a candle burning down over what appears to be a long period, wax pooling and running down one side. The flame flickers in a draft and briefly gutters without going out. The background stays dark and static.

A 3D printer lays down successive layers of a small plastic bracket, the nozzle tracing each cross-section while the bed shifts. Thin strings of filament bridge a gap and are later cleared. The finished part sits on the bed at the end, still on its raft.

A dishwasher-safe glass sits under a tap as water fills it, refracting the background and throwing a moving highlight onto the counter. The water overflows briefly, then the tap shuts off and the surface settles. No people appear in the frame.

A mechanical watch movement is shown in macro, the balance wheel oscillating back and forth and the escapement ticking in step. Gears of decreasing size mesh across the frame. The metal is polished and catches the light with each swing.

A row of dominoes arranged in a curve topples in sequence after a finger tips the first one. The cascade runs the length of the table, pauses at a small gap bridged by a ruler, and continues to the last piece. A hand reaches in at the end to reset them.

A skateboarder rolls toward a handrail, ollies onto it, grinds down its length, and lands cleanly on the far side before rolling out of frame. A second skater watches from the top of the stairs. The attempt looks like a make on the first try.

In a five-a-side football match, a player receives a pass on the wing, cuts inside past one defender, and strikes low across the goalkeeper into the far corner. Teammates run over to celebrate near the corner flag. The scoreboard is not visible.

A climber works up an overhanging indoor bouldering wall, matches hands on a large hold, then dynamically jumps to a higher grip and sticks it. They top out over the lip and lower off onto the mat. Two people spot from below.

A cyclist descends a winding mountain road, leaning through switchbacks and braking hard before a tight left-hander. A car is briefly visible ahead but turns off. The rider stays in an aerodynamic tuck on the straighter sections.

A swimmer executes a racing dive off the blocks, surfaces into freestyle, and completes a flip turn at the far wall. The stroke is even and the lane lines separate the pool into distinct lanes. The clip ends before the finish.

A tennis player serves, moves to the net behind the serve, and puts away a volley into the open court as the opponent scrambles wide. The point ends with the opponent's return going long. The match is on an outdoor hard court in daylight.
